references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Four moth wings, one thorax and two antennae. Reaction bends thorax and sweeps wings; collapse folds intact wings low against the ground. No human limbs. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical oversized moth, four ragged triangular midnight-blue wings, pale silver wing veins and moonlike empty markings, small dark segmented body and fine antennae, restrained lilac wisps. Clear wing silhouette, no human face. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows: TEN complete poses, same anatomical scale, no text. Read left to right: poses 1-4 QUICK FLINCH: 1 ready; 2 head and shoulders jerk backward visibly; 3 wings counter-sweep to catch balance; 4 fully recovered ready. Poses 5-10 HEAVY STAGGER: 5 ready; 6 abrupt head and torso recoil; 7 deepest hunched recoil and visibly lost balance; 8 wings sweep low to catch descent; 9 pushing back toward ready; 10 fully recovered ready. Show clear torso articulation and varied wing sweeps; not repeated standing duplicates. Four moth wings, six fine insect legs, thorax and two antennae. Keep hovering throughout, wing sweeps and thorax recoil, no human anatomy. No falling or lying poses in this sheet. The difference between ready and peak recoil must read at small game size. Wide empty gutters, no clipped parts. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.
input.referenceConsumption: agy receives all named image references; creatures always include original approved Covenant creature source; Grok wrapper consumes first identity image only, Covenant style block is textual

arguments.Prompt: 2D game character animation sprite sheet featuring an oversized magical creature, a hush moth, set against a solid pure vivid magenta (#FF00FF) background. Exactly 5 columns and 2 rows, containing exactly 10 complete sprite poses arranged in a 5x2 grid. Equal cell sizing with wide empty magenta margins and gutters between sprites; no sprite touches or crosses cell boundaries. No text, numbers, labels, grid lines, or borders. Creature identity and anatomy: A raw magical animal moth creature only (strictly non-humanoid, no clothing, no weapons, no hands, no human face). Features four ragged triangular midnight-blue wings with glowing pale silver wing veins and crescent moon-like markings, a small dark segmented thorax and abdomen, six fine insect legs, and two feathery antennae with subtle lilac wisps. Perspective: High angle elevated 55-degree orthographic perspective, seen from a REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view facing diagonally away from the camera toward the right, showing back surfaces and dorsal wing surfaces consistently across all poses. Poses (read left-to-right across two rows): Top row (Poses 1 to 5): Pose 1 Ready hovering pose; Pose 2 Quick flinch with head and thorax jerking backward; Pose 3 Wings counter-sweep to catch balance; Pose 4 Fully recovered ready; Pose 5 Heavy stagger start ready hover. Bottom row (Poses 6 to 10): Pose 6 Abrupt heavy recoil with head and torso thrown backward; Pose 7 Deepest hunched recoil with visibly lost balance; Pose 8 Wings sweep low to catch descent; Pose 9 Pushing back toward ready; Pose 10 Fully recovered ready hover. Style: Stylized hand-painted dark fantasy digital art matching Reference-1 and Reference-2, consistent anatomical scale across all 10 poses, clean silhouette cutout on uniform flat magenta background, cool directional lighting from top-left, rich sculpted volumes.
